business_problem: ATV Big Air Tour needed a way for a two-person leadership team to keep event information accurate, manage merchandise, and improve discoverability without adding a larger operations or marketing staff.
solution_summary: ATV Big Air Tour turned ChatGPT Work into an operating assistant for marketing, merchandising, and AI-search visibility. The team created a scheduled daily workflow that scans priority event-listing sites, flags inconsistent dates or ticket details, suggests the right publication contacts, and drafts correction emails so the founders can keep nearly 26 tour dates accurate across the web. They also use ChatGPT Work as a multimodal inventory assistant by uploading merchandise photos, letting the system organize the catalog, generate a spreadsheet and visual inventory site, and recommend reorder quantities before the founders make final adjustments. A third automation audits the company website for AI-search readability, surfacing issues such as missing FAQ structure and suggesting changes that improve discoverability in ChatGPT-style search. Together these workflows converted repetitive coordination work into repeatable digital operations for a very small team.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Work
solution_components.role: Runs scheduled event audits, image-based inventory analysis, and AI-search optimization workflows for the two-person team.

data_flow: Event listings, website content, and merchandise photos are fed into ChatGPT Work. It audits listings, drafts correction emails, structures inventory into spreadsheets and reorder plans, and reviews the website for AI-search discoverability before Larissa approves and sends the outputs.
business_outcome: ATV Big Air Tour cut event-listing review time from about eight hours to one hour per week, reduced inventory and reordering work from two to three days to two to three hours, and dramatically increased AI-search visibility while keeping a two-person team competitive.
